cells.en: The person who helped me is my neighbor.
cells.ar: الشخص الذي ساعدني هو جاري.
cells.description: Neighbor helping carry groceries

cells.en: The person who teaches science is very patient.
cells.ar: الشخص الذي يُدرّس العلوم صبور جدًا.
cells.description: Patient science instructor teaching adults

cells.en: The person who called yesterday is my cousin.
cells.ar: الشخص الذي اتصل أمس هو ابن عمي.
cells.description: Adult greeting a visiting cousin

cells.en: The person who won the race trained every day.
cells.ar: الشخص الذي فاز بالسباق كان يتدرب كل يوم.
cells.description: Athlete finishing a race

cells.en: The person who found my wallet works here.
cells.ar: الشخص الذي وجد محفظتي يعمل هنا.
cells.description: Worker returning a lost wallet

cells.en: The person who is speaking now organized the trip.
cells.ar: الشخص الذي يتحدث الآن نظم الرحلة.
cells.description: Trip organizer addressing a group

cells.en: The person who repaired the bicycle is my uncle.
cells.ar: الشخص الذي أصلح الدراجة هو عمي.
cells.description: Adult mechanic beside a repaired bicycle

cells.en: The person who sits near the window speaks Arabic.
cells.ar: الشخص الذي يجلس قرب النافذة يتحدث العربية.
cells.description: Learner seated beside a classroom window

cells.en: The person who brought these flowers is waiting outside.
cells.ar: الشخص الذي أحضر هذه الزهور ينتظر في الخارج.
cells.description: Visitor waiting beside a bouquet

cells.en: The person who knows the route will lead us.
cells.ar: الشخص الذي يعرف الطريق سيقودنا.
cells.description: Guide consulting a trail map

cells.en: The person who designed this garden lives nearby.
cells.ar: الشخص الذي صمم هذه الحديقة يسكن بالقرب من هنا.
cells.description: Garden designer talking with visitors

cells.en: The person who answered the phone was very helpful.
cells.ar: الشخص الذي رد على الهاتف كان متعاونًا جدًا.
cells.description: Receptionist helping a caller

title: الكتاب الذي
form: the thing or book that + relative clause

cells.en: The book that I borrowed is very interesting.
cells.ar: الكتاب الذي استعرته ممتع جدًا.
cells.description: Learner reading a borrowed book

cells.en: The song that we heard was beautiful.
cells.ar: الأغنية التي سمعناها كانت جميلة.
cells.description: Friends listening to a beautiful song

cells.en: The phone that she bought works well.
cells.ar: الهاتف الذي اشترته يعمل جيدًا.
cells.description: Adult inspecting a newly purchased phone

cells.en: The picture that he drew tells a story.
cells.ar: الصورة التي رسمها تروي قصة.
cells.description: Artist showing a narrative drawing

cells.en: The coat that I bought last winter still fits.
cells.ar: المعطف الذي اشتريته الشتاء الماضي ما زال يناسبني.
cells.description: Adult trying on a winter coat

cells.en: The recipe that you shared was easy to follow.
cells.ar: الوصفة التي شاركتها كانت سهلة الاتباع.
cells.description: Cook following a friend's recipe

cells.en: The chair that we repaired is in the garden.
cells.ar: الكرسي الذي أصلحناه في الحديقة.
cells.description: Adults placing a repaired garden chair

cells.en: The message that she sent explained the problem.
cells.ar: الرسالة التي أرسلتها أوضحت المشكلة.
cells.description: Adult reviewing an explanatory phone message

cells.en: The tool that he needs is in the blue box.
cells.ar: الأداة التي يحتاج إليها في الصندوق الأزرق.
cells.description: Worker opening a blue toolbox

cells.en: The course that I joined includes conversation practice.
cells.ar: الدورة التي التحقت بها تشمل تدريبًا على المحادثة.
cells.description: Adult learner joining a conversation class

cells.en: The bread that they bake sells out every morning.
cells.ar: الخبز الذي يخبزونه ينفد كل صباح.
cells.description: Customers buying fresh bakery bread

cells.en: The book that changed my mind was a gift from a friend.
cells.ar: الكتاب الذي غير رأيي كان هدية من صديق.
cells.description: Adult discussing a meaningful gift book

cells.en: We revisited the place where we first met. It is now a library.
cells.ar: عدنا إلى المكان الذي التقينا فيه أول مرة. وقد أصبح مكتبة الآن.
cells.description: Friends revisiting a former meeting place

cells.en: She works at the café where we met last summer.
cells.ar: تعمل في المقهى الذي التقينا فيه الصيف الماضي.
cells.description: Woman working at a familiar cafe

cells.en: I often think about the village where I grew up.
cells.ar: كثيرًا ما أفكر في القرية التي نشأت فيها.
cells.description: Adult remembering a childhood village

cells.en: We like the room where we study because it has large windows.
cells.ar: نحب الغرفة التي ندرس فيها لأنها ذات نوافذ كبيرة.
cells.description: Learners studying in a bright room

cells.en: This is the place where we leave our bicycles.
cells.ar: هذا هو المكان الذي نترك فيه دراجاتنا.
cells.description: Adults parking bicycles in a designated area

cells.en: I want to show you the place where my grandfather worked.
cells.ar: أريد أن أريك المكان الذي عمل فيه جدي.
cells.description: Adult showing a relative an old workshop

cells.en: We found a place where we could sit in the shade.
cells.ar: وجدنا مكانًا نستطيع الجلوس فيه في الظل.
cells.description: Walkers resting beneath a shady tree

cells.en: The place where we camped was close to a river.
cells.ar: كان المكان الذي خيمنا فيه قريبًا من نهر.
cells.description: Campers beside a riverside tent

cells.en: Do you remember the place where we bought the bread?
cells.ar: هل تتذكر المكان الذي اشترينا منه الخبز؟
cells.description: Friends looking for a familiar bakery

cells.en: They need a place where everyone can hear the speaker.
cells.ar: يحتاجون إلى مكان يستطيع الجميع فيه سماع المتحدث.
cells.description: Organizers inspecting an event room

cells.en: The place where I study stays quiet in the evening.
cells.ar: يظل المكان الذي أدرس فيه هادئًا مساءً.
cells.description: Adult reading in a quiet evening library

cells.en: We returned to the place where she had lost her keys.
cells.ar: عدنا إلى المكان الذي كانت قد أضاعت فيه مفاتيحها.
cells.description: Friends searching a familiar park bench

cells.en: I will always remember the day when we graduated.
cells.ar: سأتذكر دائمًا اليوم الذي تخرجنا فيه.
cells.description: Graduates celebrating together

cells.en: We recall the day when she arrived in the rain.
cells.ar: نتذكر اليوم الذي وصلت فيه تحت المطر.
cells.description: Friends recalling an arrival in rain

cells.en: I still think about the day when I started school.
cells.ar: ما زلت أفكر في اليوم الذي بدأت فيه المدرسة.
cells.description: Adult looking at a first-school-day photograph

cells.en: We all remember the day when he smiled at us.
cells.ar: نتذكر جميعًا اليوم الذي ابتسم فيه لنا.
cells.description: Family remembering a shared happy day

cells.en: The day when I first spoke English still makes me smile.
cells.ar: ما زال اليوم الذي تحدثت فيه الإنجليزية لأول مرة يجعلني أبتسم.
cells.description: Adult recalling an early language lesson

cells.en: We remember the day when our neighbors moved in.
cells.ar: نتذكر اليوم الذي انتقل فيه جيراننا إلى هنا.
cells.description: Neighbors greeting a moving family

cells.en: I kept the ticket from the day when we visited the museum.
cells.ar: احتفظت بتذكرة اليوم الذي زرنا فيه المتحف.
cells.description: Adult looking at a saved museum ticket

cells.en: She described the day when she opened her shop.
cells.ar: وصفت اليوم الذي افتتحت فيه متجرها.
cells.description: Shopkeeper showing an opening-day photograph

cells.en: The day when we planted that tree was very windy.
cells.ar: كان اليوم الذي غرسنا فيه تلك الشجرة عاصفًا جدًا.
cells.description: Adults tending a tree they planted

cells.en: Do you remember the day when the bridge reopened?
cells.ar: هل تتذكر اليوم الذي أعيد فيه فتح الجسر؟
cells.description: Friends standing beside a reopened bridge

cells.en: I will never forget the day when my brother returned home.
cells.ar: لن أنسى أبدًا اليوم الذي عاد فيه أخي إلى المنزل.
cells.description: Family warmly welcoming a returning relative

cells.en: We chose the day when everyone would be free.
cells.ar: اخترنا اليوم الذي سيكون الجميع فيه متفرغين.
cells.description: Group agreeing on a shared meeting date

title: أتمنى لو استطعت
form: I wish I could + base verb

cells.en: I wish I could visit my grandparents today.
cells.ar: أتمنى لو أستطيع زيارة جدي وجدتي اليوم.
cells.description: Adult hoping to visit grandparents

cells.en: I wish I could speak every language.
cells.ar: أتمنى لو أستطيع التحدث بكل اللغات.
cells.description: Learner imagining multilingual conversation

cells.en: I wish I could join the trip tomorrow.
cells.ar: أتمنى لو أستطيع الانضمام إلى رحلة الغد.
cells.description: Adult unable to join a planned trip

cells.en: I wish I could play the piano well.
cells.ar: أتمنى لو أستطيع العزف على البيانو جيدًا.
cells.description: Adult admiring a skilled pianist

cells.en: I wish I could stay a little longer.
cells.ar: أتمنى لو استطعت البقاء قليلًا بعد.
cells.description: Guest reluctantly preparing to leave

cells.en: I wish I could understand every word of this conversation.
cells.ar: أتمنى لو استطعت فهم كل كلمة في هذه المحادثة.
cells.description: Learner listening attentively to a discussion

cells.en: I wish I could help you move tomorrow.
cells.ar: أتمنى لو استطعت مساعدتك في الانتقال غدًا.
cells.description: Adult apologetically discussing a friend's move

cells.en: I wish I could remember people's names more easily.
cells.ar: أتمنى لو استطعت تذكر أسماء الناس بسهولة أكبر.
cells.description: Adult greeting people at a gathering

cells.en: I wish I could take a month off to travel.
cells.ar: أتمنى لو استطعت أخذ إجازة شهر للسفر.
cells.description: Worker looking at travel photographs during a break

cells.en: I wish I could repair this old bicycle myself.
cells.ar: أتمنى لو استطعت إصلاح هذه الدراجة القديمة بنفسي.
cells.description: Adult examining an old bicycle

cells.en: I wish I could see the sea from my window.
cells.ar: أتمنى لو استطعت رؤية البحر من نافذتي.
cells.description: Adult looking through an inland apartment window

cells.en: I wish I could speak without feeling so nervous.
cells.ar: أتمنى لو استطعت التحدث دون شعور بهذا التوتر.
cells.description: Learner preparing to speak to a group

title: لو كنت
form: If I were + imaginary situation, I would + base verb

cells.en: If I were a teacher, I would make lessons fun.
cells.ar: لو كنت معلمًا، لجعلت الدروس ممتعة.
cells.description: Adult imagining teaching an engaging lesson

cells.en: If I were taller, I would reach that shelf.
cells.ar: لو كنت أطول، لوصلت إلى ذلك الرف.
cells.description: Adult unable to reach a shelf

cells.en: If I were the team leader, I would ask everyone.
cells.ar: لو كنت قائد الفريق، لاستشرت الجميع.
cells.description: Team considering a leadership role

cells.en: If I were you, I would rest before the exam.
cells.ar: لو كنت مكانك، لاستَرحت قبل الاختبار.
cells.description: Friend offering study advice

cells.en: If I were a chef, I would create a new soup every week.
cells.ar: لو كنت طاهيًا، لابتكرت حساءً جديدًا كل أسبوع.
cells.description: Adult imagining cooking beside recipe books

cells.en: If I were free today, I would join your walk.
cells.ar: لو كنت متفرغًا اليوم، لانضممت إلى نزهتكم.
cells.description: Busy adult speaking with walkers

cells.en: If I were closer to the station, I would walk there.
cells.ar: لو كنت أقرب إلى المحطة، لمشيت إليها.
cells.description: Traveler comparing distance on a map

cells.en: If I were in charge, I would listen to the whole team.
cells.ar: لو كنت المسؤول، لأصغيت إلى الفريق كله.
cells.description: Adult considering a fair team discussion

cells.en: If I were better at drawing, I would sketch this view.
cells.ar: لو كنت أجيد الرسم أكثر، لرسمت هذا المنظر.
cells.description: Visitor admiring a landscape with a sketchbook

cells.en: If I were you, I would ask for clearer instructions.
cells.ar: لو كنت مكانك، لطلبت تعليمات أوضح.
cells.description: Friend advising a learner over confusing instructions

cells.en: If I were the owner, I would add more windows.
cells.ar: لو كنت المالك، لأضفت نوافذ أكثر.
cells.description: Adult examining a dim room

cells.en: If I were less busy, I would volunteer more often.
cells.ar: لو كنت أقل انشغالًا، لتطوعت مرات أكثر.
cells.description: Worker looking at a community volunteering invitation

title: لو كنت قد ... لكنت قد
form: If + past perfect, subject + would have + past participle

cells.en: If I had left early, I would have caught the bus.
cells.ar: لو غادرت مبكرًا، لكنت لحقت بالحافلة.
cells.description: Traveler regretting a missed bus

cells.en: If she had practiced, she would have felt ready.
cells.ar: لو تدربت، لشعرت بالاستعداد.
cells.description: Learner recalling insufficient practice

cells.en: If we had checked the map, we would have arrived sooner.
cells.ar: لو راجعنا الخريطة، لوصلنا أبكر.
cells.description: Travelers checking a map after a delay

cells.en: If he had saved the file, he would have kept his work.
cells.ar: لو حفظ الملف، لاحتفظ بعمله.
cells.description: Adult discovering unsaved computer work

cells.en: If I had brought my glasses, I would have read the menu.
cells.ar: لو أحضرت نظارتي، لقرأت قائمة الطعام.
cells.description: Diner searching for missing glasses

cells.en: If we had booked earlier, we would have found cheaper rooms.
cells.ar: لو حجزنا مبكرًا، لوجدنا غرفًا أرخص.
cells.description: Travelers reviewing expensive last-minute bookings

cells.en: If she had seen your message, she would have called you.
cells.ar: لو رأت رسالتك، لاتصلت بك.
cells.description: Woman discovering an unread message

cells.en: If he had checked the weather, he would have packed a coat.
cells.ar: لو تحقق من الطقس، لحزم معطفًا.
cells.description: Traveler feeling cold beside an open suitcase

cells.en: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended.
cells.ar: لو عرفت بالاجتماع، لحضرته.
cells.description: Adult finding a missed meeting notice

cells.en: If we had watered the plants, they would have survived.
cells.ar: لو سقينا النباتات، لبقيت حية.
cells.description: Adults inspecting dried plants

cells.en: If you had asked me, I would have lent you the book.
cells.ar: لو طلبت مني، لأعرتك الكتاب.
cells.description: Friends discussing a book after a missed opportunity

cells.en: If I had taken your advice, I would have avoided the mistake.
cells.ar: لو أخذت بنصيحتك، لتجنبت الخطأ.
cells.description: Adult reviewing a regretted decision with a friend

cells.en: I should have checked the meeting time.
cells.ar: كان ينبغي أن أتحقق من موعد الاجتماع.
cells.description: Adult realizing a mistaken meeting time

cells.en: I should have brought my umbrella.
cells.ar: كان ينبغي أن أحضر مظلتي.
cells.description: Adult caught in rain without an umbrella

cells.en: I should have listened more carefully.
cells.ar: كان ينبغي أن أستمع بعناية أكبر.
cells.description: Learner reviewing a missed instruction

cells.en: I should have saved my work earlier.
cells.ar: كان ينبغي أن أحفظ عملي مبكرًا.
cells.description: Worker discovering unsaved work

cells.en: I should have asked before using your bicycle.
cells.ar: كان ينبغي أن أستأذن قبل استخدام دراجتك.
cells.description: Adult apologizing beside a borrowed bicycle

cells.en: I should have packed less for this short trip.
cells.ar: كان ينبغي أن أحزم أغراضًا أقل لهذه الرحلة القصيرة.
cells.description: Traveler struggling with an oversized suitcase

cells.en: I should have written down the address.
cells.ar: كان ينبغي أن أدوّن العنوان.
cells.description: Traveler trying to recall a destination

cells.en: I should have thanked her for all her help.
cells.ar: كان ينبغي أن أشكرها على كل مساعدتها.
cells.description: Adult remembering a helpful colleague

cells.en: I should have checked the opening hours.
cells.ar: كان ينبغي أن أتحقق من ساعات العمل.
cells.description: Visitor standing outside a closed museum

cells.en: I should have taken a break before continuing.
cells.ar: كان ينبغي أن آخذ استراحة قبل المواصلة.
cells.description: Tired worker resting beside a completed task

cells.en: I should have explained what I meant.
cells.ar: كان ينبغي أن أوضح ما قصدته.
cells.description: Adults resolving a misunderstanding

cells.en: I should have called instead of sending a message.
cells.ar: كان ينبغي أن أتصل بدلًا من إرسال رسالة.
cells.description: Adult looking at an unanswered message

cells.en: I could have taken the earlier bus.
cells.ar: كان بإمكاني ركوب الحافلة الأسبق.
cells.description: Traveler considering an earlier bus

cells.en: She could have asked for help.
cells.ar: كان بإمكانها طلب المساعدة.
cells.description: Adult recalling an available offer of help

cells.en: We could have finished the work together.
cells.ar: كان بإمكاننا إنهاء العمل معًا.
cells.description: Colleagues discussing shared work

cells.en: He could have called before arriving.
cells.ar: كان بإمكانه الاتصال قبل الوصول.
cells.description: Guest recalling an unmade phone call

cells.en: I could have borrowed a bike, but I chose to walk.
cells.ar: كان بإمكاني استعارة دراجة، لكنني اخترت المشي.
cells.description: Adult walking past an available bicycle

cells.en: I could have stayed longer, but I left after dinner.
cells.ar: كان بإمكاني البقاء أطول، لكنني غادرت بعد العشاء.
cells.description: Guest preparing to leave a gathering

cells.en: I could have ordered online, but I went to the shop.
cells.ar: كان بإمكاني الطلب عبر الإنترنت، لكنني ذهبت إلى المتجر.
cells.description: Shopper entering a store with a phone

cells.en: I could have taken a taxi, but the bus was cheaper.
cells.ar: كان بإمكاني ركوب سيارة أجرة، لكن الحافلة كانت أرخص.
cells.description: Traveler choosing a bus over a taxi

cells.en: I could have helped with the boxes if you had asked.
cells.ar: كان بإمكاني المساعدة في الصناديق لو طلبت مني.
cells.description: Friends discussing a completed move

cells.en: I could have brought lunch from home.
cells.ar: كان بإمكاني إحضار الغداء من المنزل.
cells.description: Worker looking at an empty lunch bag

cells.en: I could have practiced with my neighbor yesterday.
cells.ar: كان بإمكاني التدرب مع جاري أمس.
cells.description: Adult discussing a missed practice opportunity

cells.en: I could have used the quieter room, but I didn't know it was free.
cells.ar: كان بإمكاني استخدام الغرفة الأهدأ، لكنني لم أعرف أنها كانت شاغرة.
cells.description: Adult discovering a quiet empty room

title: كنت قد فعلت بالفعل
form: I had already + past participle + before past event

cells.en: I had already eaten when my friend called.
cells.ar: كنت قد تناولت الطعام عندما اتصل صديقي.
cells.description: Adult receiving a call after eating

cells.en: She had already finished the book before Monday.
cells.ar: كانت قد أنهت الكتاب قبل الاثنين.
cells.description: Woman finishing a book before a deadline

cells.en: We had already left when the rain started.
cells.ar: كنا قد غادرنا عندما بدأ المطر.
cells.description: Travelers already departed when rain begins

cells.en: He had already sent the email before the meeting.
cells.ar: كان قد أرسل البريد قبل الاجتماع.
cells.description: Worker sending email before a meeting

cells.en: I had already bought the tickets before the price went up.
cells.ar: كنت قد اشتريت التذاكر بالفعل قبل ارتفاع السعر.
cells.description: Traveler looking at previously purchased tickets

cells.en: I had already cleaned the kitchen when the guests arrived.
cells.ar: كنت قد نظفت المطبخ بالفعل عندما وصل الضيوف.
cells.description: Host welcoming guests from a clean kitchen

cells.en: I had already heard the news before you told me.
cells.ar: كنت قد سمعت الخبر بالفعل قبل أن تخبرني.
cells.description: Friends discussing familiar news

cells.en: I had already packed my bag when she offered to help.
cells.ar: كنت قد حزمت حقيبتي بالفعل عندما عرضت المساعدة.
cells.description: Adult beside a packed travel bag

cells.en: I had already returned the book before I received the reminder.
cells.ar: كنت قد أعدت الكتاب بالفعل قبل أن يصلني التذكير.
cells.description: Library visitor checking a return reminder

cells.en: I had already met him once before we worked together.
cells.ar: كنت قد قابلته مرة بالفعل قبل أن نعمل معًا.
cells.description: Colleagues recalling an earlier meeting

cells.en: I had already turned off the lights when I heard the knock.
cells.ar: كنت قد أطفأت الأنوار بالفعل عندما سمعت الطرق.
cells.description: Adult pausing in a dark hallway at a knock

cells.en: I had already written the answer before the teacher explained it.
cells.ar: كنت قد كتبت الإجابة بالفعل قبل أن يشرحها المعلم.
cells.description: Learner showing a completed answer
